thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - automated alert: sudden 10x increase in 429/OVER_THROTTLE responses from hosted API after rollout r12 at 2024-06-21 15:03 UTC. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, embeddings.

jamie (oncall): I'm on it. Paging infra and releases. @kevin can you confirm what went out in r12?

kevin (releases): r12 rolled the new ratecap routing + exemptions refactor. Canary looked fine on my side. Deployed at 15:01 UTC via deploy-bot. Patch: https://ci/release/r12

maria (eng-runtime): seeing consistent 429s with header x-ratecap-reason=OVER_THROTTLE. Logs show token accounting mismatch on requests that should've been exempted (dedicated customers and sandbox tokens).

lina (support): we already got two customer reports: AcmePay and Stellar Health seeing failed calls; support is triaging and collecting examples.

devops-bot: deploy r12 metadata:
`````
service: ratecap
flag: ratecap_v2_enable=true
canary: 5%
targets: hosted-api region-us
`````

sre-lead: Jamie, please run the rollback / kill-switch checklist. We prioritise customer-facing kill-switch first.

jamie (oncall): Initiating kill-switch for r12 ratecap flag to stop new behavior. @kevin hold new releases.

kevin (releases): ack. flipping feature flag now.

maria (eng-runtime): Before full rollback — quick mitigation: re-enable exemptions map from r11. I have the patch ready: revert missing exemptions patch in routing table.

jamie (oncall): Command I'm running:
`````
# temporarily disable new ratecap policy
kubectl set env deploy/ratecap ratecap_v2_enable=false -n prod
`````

devops-bot: env update queued on 12 pods, rolling restart started.

maria (eng-runtime): also applying hotfix to reinstate exemptions:
`````
curl -X POST https://admin-api/internal/exemptions/refresh -d '{"source":"r11-backfill"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'
`````

kevin (releases): rolling hold put in place. No new deploys to hosted-api until postmortem.

lina (support): Support update: AcmePay saw 25% failures over 10 mins; Stellar Health partial degrade but no data loss. Notifying their SRE contacts. ETA to reduce errors depends on flag flip.

jamie (oncall): After flag flip, 429 rate dropped within 2 mins to baseline. Monitoring for 15 min to confirm. No data loss reported.

sre-lead: Good. Initiate customer-visible update and incident page. Lina draft message for customers.

lina (support): Draft: \"We experienced elevated rate-limiting errors for some API requests due to a rollout. We rolled back the change and restored normal service. If you continue to see errors please contact support@redwood.com and include request ids.\"

maria (eng-runtime): Root cause: exemptions map merge conflict in release branch — the canary didn't exercise full token set, so missing exemptions made many requests fall through to new throttle. Fix: add stronger integration test + pre-deploy exemption diff check.

kevin (releases): We'll add a gating check to CI to compare exemptions set sizes and fail if change >0 without explicit approval.

sre-lead: Actions assigned: Maria => fix + test (PR), Kevin => CI gating, Jamie => postmortem + timeline, Lina => customer comms. Escalation closed after 30m handover to oncall rotation.

jamie (oncall): handing off to next oncall @alex for monitoring follow-up and postmortem writeup. End of active mitigation.

incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved (mitigated). Created incident ticket INC-2024-1034 and scheduled postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

alex (next-oncall): acked, will pick up on timeline and ensure follow-through.
